e.title: 日本金融厅统计（FSA Statistics）
e.summary: 日本金融厅英文统计页：主要保险公司财务结果概览 + 银行/不良贷款/衍生品等金融统计
e.summary_en: The Japan FSA’s English statistics page: overview of major insurance companies’ financial results plus banking, NPL and derivatives statistics
e.summary_hk: 日本金融廳英文統計頁：主要保險公司財務結果概覽 + 銀行/不良貸款/衍生品等金融統計
e.body: 日本金融厅（Financial Services Agency, FSA）的英文统计页（`fsa.go.jp/en/regulated/statistics/`）是**日本金融监管口径的一手数据入口**，栏目包括：**Overview of financial results of major insurance companies**（主要保险公司财务结果概览——保险业最关键的一栏）、Status of Non-Performing Loans（不良贷款状况）、Overview of major banks’ / regional banks’ financial results、subprime-related product exposures、OTC 衍生品交易汇总、存款保险机构（DICJ）金融援助与资本注入、以及日本银行（BOJ）统计的入口。对 RIAA：本 wiki 的亚洲监管统计轴此前已有日本**行业协会口径**（[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]，LIAJ 的月度统计与 Fact Book），但**监管机构口径**缺位——FSA 这一栏正好补上「监管者眼中的日本保险业财务结果」，两者构成「行业统计 vs 监管披露」的配对（同一市场两个口径互相校验，是做市场分析作业时最容易踩坑的地方）；可与中国（[[nfra-statistics]]）、韩国（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）、台湾（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）、新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、澳洲（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]）在区域内横向比较，跨国口径见 [[oecd-insurance-data]] 与 [[iais-gimar]]；适合作亚洲市场分析、监管比较与跨国财务对比。
e.body_en: The English statistics page of Japan’s Financial Services Agency (FSA, `fsa.go.jp/en/regulated/statistics/`) is **a first-hand data entry point for Japan’s financial regulatory perspective**. Its sections include: **Overview of financial results of major insurance companies** (the key one for insurance), status of non-performing loans, overviews of major and regional banks’ financial results, subprime-related product exposures, aggregates of OTC derivative transactions, financial assistance and capital injection by the Deposit Insurance Corporation of Japan, and a gateway to Bank of Japan statistics. For RIAA: this wiki’s Asian regulatory-statistics axis already had Japan at the **industry-association level** ([[japan-life-insurance-statistics]], LIAJ’s monthly statistics and Fact Book) but was **missing the regulator’s view** — the FSA section supplies exactly "the Japanese insurance industry’s financial results as the supervisor sees them", forming a pair with the industry data as "**industry statistics vs regulatory disclosure**" (two perspectives on one market that cross-check each other — and the easiest place to slip up in a market-analysis assignment); it supports regional comparison with China ([[nfra-statistics]]), Korea ([[fss-korea-insurance]]), Taiwan ([[tii-taiwan-insurance]]), Singapore ([[mas-insurance-statistics]]) and Australia ([[apra-insurance-statistics]]), and cross-country series via [[oecd-insurance-data]] and [[iais-gimar]]; suits Asian market analysis, regulatory comparison and cross-country financial comparison.
e.body_hk: 日本金融廳（Financial Services Agency, FSA）的英文統計頁（`fsa.go.jp/en/regulated/statistics/`）是**日本金融監管口徑的一手數據入口**，欄目包括：**Overview of financial results of major insurance companies**（主要保險公司財務結果概覽——保險業最關鍵的一欄）、不良貸款狀況、主要銀行/地區銀行財務結果、次貸相關產品敞口、OTC 衍生品交易匯總、存款保險機構金融援助與資本注入、以及日本銀行（BOJ）統計入口。對 RIAA：本 wiki 的亞洲監管統計軸此前已有日本**行業協會口徑**（[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]），但**監管機構口徑**缺位——FSA 這一欄正好補上「監管者眼中的日本保險業財務結果」，兩者構成「行業統計 vs 監管披露」的配對；可與中國（[[nfra-statistics]]）、韓國（[[fss-korea-insurance]]）、台灣（[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）、新加坡（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]）、澳洲（[[apra-insurance-statistics]]）橫向比較，跨國口徑見 [[oecd-insurance-data]] 與 [[iais-gimar]]；適合作亞洲市場分析、監管比較與跨國財務對比。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测 + 栏目核实（Overview of financial results of major insurance companies、不良贷款、主要/地区银行财务、次贷敞口、OTC 衍生品、DICJ、BOJ Statistics）
